name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 1 campaign ran, Regional Class A — Joliet, spending $214.50 for 7 leads at $30.64 per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet had 10,230 impressions and 152 clicks, a 1.5% click rate, and brought in 7 leads at $30.64 per lead.
Spend so far in November 2026 is $214.50, all on Meta, with 27 days left in the month.
The 2026-10-05 cohort of 19 leads: 15 contacted, 5 converted (26.3%), 3 applied (15.8%) and no hires yet. 4 had their application end without a hire (21.1%).
The 2026-10-19 cohort of 23 leads is too young to judge: 17 contacted, 6 converted, 2 applied, and 1 application ended without a hire.
The 2026-11-02 cohort has 7 leads so far, 3 contacted and none converted yet. It is too young to judge.
The sheet has no call results for any campaign over the last 14 days, so there is nothing to report on wrong numbers or missed hard requirements.
